brief:
Colombia has withdrawn its declaration of intervention in South Africa's genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice, Middle East Eye reported. The withdrawal came through an Article 63 declaration, which allows countries to formally participate in ICJ proceedings involving the interpretation of genocide convention obligations.

South Africa filed the case accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza, and Colombia's intervention would have allowed it to present arguments on how the genocide convention applies to the conflict. The country's decision to withdraw marks a shift in its previous position supporting the case.
dek: Colombia withdraws its ICJ intervention in Gaza genocide case Colombia has withdrawn its Article 63 declaration of intervention in South Africa’s Gaza genocide case against Israel, according to the International Court of Justice.
title: Colombia withdraws from ICJ Gaza genocide case
